Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Politics Fifi Kwetey, Yameen, Ako Gunn go unopposed in NDC national executive race Source : Myjoyonline.com 9 November 2026 8:13pm ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
The National Democratic Congress (NDC) has released the list of aspirants for its national executive elections scheduled for December 2026, with several key positions attracting no contest.
The list, revealed on Monday, November 9, shows that four candidates are seeking the position of National Chairman, while Fifi Fiavi Kwetey, Joseph Yameen and Ako Gunn are going unopposed for their respective positions.
Four aspirants have filed to contest for the position of National Chairman:
Four candidates are also contesting for Deputy General Secretary:
Fifi Fiavi Kwetey is the sole aspirant for the General Secretary position and is therefore going unopposed.
Joseph Yameen is also going unopposed for the position of National Organiser.
Ako Gunn is the only aspirant listed for National Communications Officer and is set to go unopposed.
Three names were provided for the National Youth Organiser position:
Nineteen individuals have filed to contest for the Vice Chair positions, according to the list.
The NDC’s national executive elections are expected to take place in December 2026, as the party prepares for the 2028 general elections.
The exercise will see the party elect national officers to steer its affairs for the next four years.
The aspirants are expected to undergo vetting, after which the party is expected to announce further details of the election timetable.
